name: joey-agent
description: Use Joey warm introduction paths from your own AI agent: read path reports, make introductions, follow up, and keep the introduction tracker true.

defaultPrompt: Use $joey to show my Joey paths and the best next introduction.
Use $joey-make-intro to write the introduction request for <target>.
Use $joey-intro-follow-up to find the introductions that need a follow-up.
Use $joey-tracker-sync to update my Joey introduction tracker from my email and calendar.
